10102011.name: Canyon Conquest
10102011.activityInstruction:
Bravery prevails in narrow encounters, while wisdom triumphs among the brave. Only those with both courage and wit can seize the final victory in desperate straits!
Participation Requirements
1. You must join an Alliance.
2. Territory Lv.10 or higher.
3. Alliance has at least 15 members registered.

Event Flow
[Registration Phase]
1. Members must manually register for Canyon Conquest, select a lane, and deploy troops. Alliances with insufficient registrations will not receive participation slots.
2. Canyon Conquest does not occupy expedition queues and causes no soldier casualties.
3. Maximum troop count per lane is determined by the current Canyon Conquest tier.
4. Higher Might troops deploy first.
5. All registered members (including those registered but not deployed) receive rewards upon successful Alliance participation.
6. If a registered member leaves the Alliance after matching begins, their troops continue competing but earn no rewards.

[Matching Phase]
1. Six Alliances of similar tier are randomly grouped together. Groups with fewer than six Alliances still form; odd-numbered groups may receive byes, automatically winning that round.
2. Registered Alliances cannot disband until Canyon Conquest ends.

[Preparation Phase]
1. Canyon Conquest uses round-robin format, with each Alliance battling the other five in their group across 5 rounds.
2. Before each round begins, members can adjust troop configurations. R5 and Officials can reassign individual troop lanes or swap troops of the entire lane.
3. After preparation and before combat, the entry phase begins and lane and troop adjustments are locked.

[Combat Phase]
1. Battle occurs across 3 lanes simultaneously.
2. Troops on each lane take turns fighting; victors continue with remaining forces against the next troop. Each Troop fights a set number of times before mandatory withdrawal.
3. The side that defeats all opposing troops on a lane wins that lane and earns Conquest Points.
4. The side with the most Conquest Points wins, gaining 3 points to the total value.
5. Equal Conquest Points result in a draw; both sides gain 1 total point.

[Settlement Phase]
1. After each round, rewards are distributed based on results, plus bonus rewards for enemy troops defeated by each allied troop.
2. After all rounds, Alliances are ranked by total points within their group and receive corresponding rewards. Ties are broken by total Troop Might deployed.
10102011.activityDesc1: Clash in the canyon. Who will be the winner?

4. Points granted by daily activities vary. Earning points unlocks reward chests from stages 1-9.

8. There are daily and weekly player points leaderboards, with ranking rewards distributed at daily and weekly settlements.

4500101.name: Cheese Trap
4500101.activityInstruction:
[Selection Phase]
1. After the event begins, Alliance R4 or R5 can choose the start time and difficulty for [Cheese Trap I]/[Cheese Trap II]. Once a trap's difficulty is set, the other will be automatically locked.
2. Activating a trap requires 20 Alliance members.
3. If [Cheese Trap I]/[Cheese Trap II] hasn't been scheduled by 22:00 server time on the last day of each session, it will expire.
4. After selection, the event enters the Preparation Phase.
[Preparation Phase]
1. All Alliance members can donate Mouse Lure to gain Alliance Contribution and damage boosts for the Trap Phase.
2. Donations are required separately for each trap, with boosts calculated individually.
3. After reaching the donation limit, members can still donate for Alliance Contribution but won't receive further damage boosts for the Extermination Phase.
4. After the event, both traps' enhancement levels reset, requiring new material donations to increase trap power.
[Extermination Phase]
1. R4 or R5 must manually activate [Cheese Trap I]/[Cheese Trap II], with only one trap active at a time for 30 minutes.
2. Once active, Cheese Thieves will be trapped, and Doctors must launch attacks via Rally.
3. R4 or Official-led Rallies deal extra damage to Cheese Thieves.
4. For offline participation, the Doctor's highest Might Troop will auto-join a Rally with 20 seconds remaining if a slot is available.
[Reward Settlement]
1. After trap time ends, the higher the personal damage dealt by Doctors, the better the personal rewards.
2. At the event's conclusion, total damage from both traps is combined. Higher cumulative damage yields richer Alliance rewards and unlocks higher difficulty traps.
3. The top-damaging Doctor for each trap will receive 1-10x Alliance rewards based on personal damage!

1) [c][F5B903]Defeat the required number of monsters for rewards.[-][/c]

5600102.activityInstruction:
Claire once watched her squad fall to the deadly Scholar Blights. Forced to strike down those she once fought beside, she has carried the burden of that day ever since.
Now, a new wave of Scholar Blights is closing in, putting the territory at risk. Fight alongside Claire and help her confront the memories she can never escape.
Complete Rally Quests to earn rare rewards!
5600102.activityDesc1: Face the painful memories and dispel the darkness within!

5900102.noticeText3: The Royal City is about to open! A new king will emerge amidst fire and glory!
5900102.name: Royal City Scramble
5900102.noticeText4: The Royal City is the most enigmatic place on the continent, shrouded in a magical barrier. Now, its mysteries are about to be unveiled. Located at the continent's center, it is of great strategic importance. Seizing the Royal City means ruling the entire continent!
5900102.noticeText5:
1. The Doctor and their alliance that continuously occupy the Royal City for 8 hours will achieve victory directly.
2. When the Royal City is contested, any Doctor can dispatch troops to it and surrounding turrets. Upon arrival, if the occupant is an alliance member, the troops will reinforce. If not, a battle ensues.
3. When the Royal City and turrets are occupied by different alliances, the turrets will launch shells at the Royal City after charging, causing significant damage to the defending troops.
4. When the same alliance occupies the buildings for {0} hours (only buildings with a continuous occupation duration exceeding {1} minutes are counted), it triggers a garrison troop buff (requires occupation of {2} or more buildings). The more buildings occupied for over {3} minutes, the better the buff.
5. The max defense troop size is determined by the occupant's rally size.
6. During the Royal City contest, 70% of troop losses in battles at the Royal City and turrets will enter the Infirmary, instead of dying instantly.

6000103.name: Path of the Recluse I
6000103.activityInstruction:
1. During the event, collect Recluse Coins from Falcon Tower, Resource Monsters, Elite Blights, Secret Squads, and Wandering Blights. Use collected Recluse Coins in the Grand Feast event.
Unused daily acquisition allowance will carry over to the following day.
6000103.activityDesc1: A little effort, a little luck, amazing rewards await you!

5700100.name: Alliance Competition
5700100.activityInstruction:
1. Alliance Duel pairs your alliance with an opponent, competing for Points during the event to determine the winner (Only alliances with more than 20 members on Sunday and ranked in the top 32 in Might on the server can participate in the match).
2. Alliance Duel consists of 6 phases, focusing on 6 main activities: Raven, Construction, Tech, Hero, Full Development I, Full Development II.
3. From Monday to Saturday, these 6 phases are held sequentially.
4. Points granted by daily activities vary. Earning points unlocks reward Chests from stages 1-9.
5. Daily settlement occurs at server time 00:00. The alliance with the higher total points wins.
6. Each phase has different winning points, and the side with more winning points at the end of the event wins.
7. There are daily and weekly player points leaderboards, with ranking rewards distributed at daily and weekly settlements.
8. Stage 4-9 reward Chests must be unlocked by researching specific techs in the Alliance Duel tech tree.
9. During Alliance Duel, if a player changes alliances, they will not contribute to alliance points for that day but can still earn personal points and claim Personal Points Rewards.

45001052.name: Blades Out
45001052.activityInstruction:
Ready for battle. Strike with steel!
During the event, Doctors can obtain Stone Blades by purchasing Blade Packs. Packs refresh daily at 0:00 server time.
1.Stone Blades can be exchanged for rewards. Each reward has a limited number of exchanges.
2.Purchasing Blade Packs also increases bonus progress. Reach the required milestones to claim corresponding rewards.
3.Purchasing Blade Packs grants the same amount of VIP points as purchasing Diamond Packs in the Shop.
45001052.activityDesc1: Buy the Blade Pack to increase event points and claim stage rewards!

14000301.name: Ruin Hunt
14000301.activityInstruction:
Ruins hold endless surprises!
Event Rules:
1. Tap cards in the elimination zone to place them in the card slots.
2. When 3 identical cards fill a slot, they're automatically eliminated.
3. Use 3 event items—Remove, Recall, and Refresh—to help you clear the stage.
Remove: Stack the first 3 cards from the slot into the removal zone (max 4 layers).
Recall: Return the last card placed in the slot to its original position.
Refresh: Randomly reshuffle card positions in the elimination zone.
4. Filling all 7 slots with cards results in challenge failure.
5. Eliminate all cards to successfully clear the stage.
